faq.question: Can two editors change the same line at once?
faq.answer: Two people can work in the same script, but Pockitle Cue does not allow unrestricted simultaneous changes to one line. A temporary editing reservation covers the whole row across its languages. Real-time collaboration depends on an eligible plan, editor permissions and availability; it is not active for every account.

faq.question: How does translation approval work?
faq.answer: Approval applies separately to each line and language. The critical distinction is this: needs review does not mean anyone may immediately rewrite it. Approved translations and translations awaiting review are both protected.

faq.question: What happens when the source changes?
faq.answer: If the director changes a source line, translations that were already protected are marked for another review.

faq.question: Does saving update the live show immediately?
faq.answer: Saving in Editor does not immediately update a deployed show. If a show is running, or its operator console already controls the performance, subtitle updates are submitted separately and applied by the operator at a suitable moment.
